description.zh-CN: 在岛上列出 fly-island 仓库 docs/tasks 里的任务：等你确认的、认领已失效的、进行中的（谁、哪条 lane）和待做的；有等你确认的事时，收起条上显示数量。点一条用默认程序打开任务文件。数据来自仓库里的 pnpm tasks --json，需要 Node。只给开发这个仓库时用，用 pnpm tasks:plugin 安装。
description.en: Lists the tasks in the fly-island repo's docs/tasks on an island page: waiting for you, stale claims, in progress (who, which lane) and to do; the collapsed bar shows how many wait for you. Click one to open its file. Reads pnpm tasks --json from the repo, so it needs Node. For developing this repo only; install with pnpm tasks:plugin.

description.zh-CN: fly-island 主工作区的路径。留空用安装时记下的目录。
description.en: The fly-island main checkout. Empty uses the folder recorded at install.
